description: IBP estimates the probability of post-sunset equatorial plasma irregularities from date, location, local time and solar activity. The empirical model was fitted to CHAMP and Swarm magnetic observations. The resource is documented by Leibniz Institute of Atmospheric Physics (IAP) at the University of Rostock. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The stated altitude, latitude, nighttime and quiet-geomagnetic ranges limit its use; it is not an all-condition ionosphere forecast. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
